keel_session.original_prompt: an internal dashboard for the whole company

io_contract.value: Staff open pages to view and filter reports; a form submits a new note.

runtime.value: Runs on the web framework's built-in development server as a single process on one laptop-class VM.

scale.value: Everyone in the company uses it during the working day, often at the same moment after the daily email.

constraints.value: Server-rendered Python. A single SQLite file. No build step, no extra services.

non_goals.value: No mobile app, no public access, no exports to spreadsheets.

done.value: A staff member can open the dashboard, filter a report, and add a note, and everyone sees it.

data_model.value: Report(id, title, body); Note(id, report_id, author, body, created_at).

error_handling.value: A bad filter shows an empty state; a missing report shows a 404 page.

auth_model.value: No sign-in and no user accounts — everyone using it sees the same data.

seed_data.value: Ships empty; the first user creates all the data.
